messages.author: Folake Adeyemi
messages.text: Test each ticket on its own clock under the Plus policy, not the customer's list. The goodwill from March counts against whatever we owe.

messages.author: Mats Lindgren
messages.text: Anything above the cap or above Folake's five thousand comes to me. Nothing is pre-approved.

messages.author: Harriet Lowe
messages.text: They would prefer it on the May invoice; a separate note only if the deadline forces it.
